text: Every item MUST come from the change text; NEVER add a feature, screen, field or area the change text does not name.
checklist: Each item's source phrase appears in the change text or the diff.

text: Every item MUST end with an italic source phrase copied from the change text.
checklist: Each item ends with an italic source phrase that is a copy of words in the change text.

text: The output MUST be one numbered Markdown checklist with [ ] boxes, numbered 1 to N across all areas.
checklist: The output is one numbered list with [ ] boxes, numbered 1 to N with no restart at each heading.

text: The output MUST group items under area headings that use the change text's own names.
checklist: Every area heading is a name the change text uses.

text: NEVER write test code, scripts or test data.
checklist: The output contains no code, script or test data.

text: Adjacent areas the change text does not name MUST go under Possible impact, not stated, as questions, NEVER as items.
checklist: Every area the change text does not name appears only under Possible impact, not stated, as a question.

text: With no change text, the skill MUST ask for it and NEVER produce a checklist.
checklist: With no change text, the reply asks for it and contains no checklist item.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained; NEVER name a repository path in SKILL.md, layers or references.
SKILL.md MUST have frontmatter with name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.
